reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random. The ticket is #8841.

Where it came from: on Oct 13 at 9:27 Tobias posted in #central-random, a channel Pree is in, that West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk. He said he'd flagged it to support on ticket #8841.

One thing I couldn't confirm: Tobias said the problem was on "Tobias's dealer account" and never named Marrow Fieldworks. A shared Central handoff note says Marrow Fieldworks was Pree's dealer account and changed hands on Jan 5, so it's very likely the same account, but the note doesn't say who took it over. In the reply I gave her the number, mentioned that gap, and suggested she check with Tobias before the customer call.

There's no account folder for Marrow Fieldworks in the shared files, and I only read channels Pree belongs to.
